text: No Reception report for 17 Nov was seen, so there is no occupancy figure for the day. The last reported figure is 93 of 183 rooms (50.8%) on 16 Nov, 44 of them Rabdan.

Reports for 17 Nov received from Operations, Maintenance, IT, Accounts and AJ1881. Reception, HR & Admin and Flower shop reports were not seen; Housekeeping and Drivers reports are still not being sent.

ADNOC’s HSE Compliance head confirmed on 17 Nov that all submitted documents were reviewed and approved and asked for the updated checklist to endorse; Operations reported the requirements approved for a 50 premium-room accommodation offer. The Ras Al Khaimah client approved a proposal for 15 premium rooms for 5 days.

Operations reported the Saadiyat Luo Oui Pilates studio and Oui Café started operations on 17 Nov. AJ1881 sales were AED 66 from 4 covers. AJ1881 asked for approval to rename the shop to Oui Cafe and for a cash purchase of critical kitchen items.

Maintenance completed 8 jobs on 17 Nov, including the ground-floor coffee machine installation, the room 102 ice machine and kitchen hood exhaust, a refrigerator replacement in room 810 and basement lift-lobby glass doors. Still open: room 706 thermostat, the rooftop calorifier leak and room 710 FCU rewinding; on 18 Nov Maintenance asked a gas boiler specialist for an inspection, quotation and AMC proposal. IT fixed 4 door issues; room 311 needs a new card reader.

The facility management company sent the elevator AMC renewal (6 elevators, Gravity) for approval and Operations forwarded it for a decision; the AMC has lapsed and Gravity cannot attend service calls until it is renewed. Operations also listed the AMC proposal for BMS and urgent maintenance under management approval. The CEO instructed IT to complete the immediate camera installation on 17 Nov, separate from the 16 additional cameras scheduled later this week.

Accounts reported no money received, no cheques deposited or returned and no overdue rent on 17 Nov, and submitted invoices to Rabdan Academy. The Etisalat bill is still awaiting approval; Operations reported the Etisalat high-speed connection approved for implementation.

Awaiting decision: elevator AMC renewal, the facility management AMC proposal (BMS, lift, Tamouh), room 710 FCU rewinding, the Etisalat bill payment, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename and kitchen cash purchase, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
